title: Page 1
content_zh:
在伸手不见五指、只比狗屋大一些的小空间里，小男孩浑身发抖，蜷缩在角落，不断乞求已经到了天堂的母亲可以来接走他。

那两个守在外头的坏人，只要他因为恐惧尖叫或大哭时，就会笑得特别开心，笑声不停刺激着他，他低下头，用双手紧紧捂着耳朵，整个人已经濒临崩溃边缘。

他和弟弟赵谚被绑架了，幸好在来这里的途中，他觑中歹徒一时疏忽的大好机会，便叫弟弟赶快先逃，一开始弟弟还不愿意，坚持要跟他在一起，是他威胁又恳求，弟弟才答应先逃出去找人来帮忙。

当时他还抱有一丝希望，但现在他已经绝望了，只求自己能尽快死去。

但要死去又何其简单？那两个坏人知道他开始不吃东西、不喝水，他们就会强行用灌食的，甚至还威胁他，如果再不吃，他们就会丢更多蟑螂跟老鼠进来，或是更好玩的东西，比如蛇。

那两个坏人以整他为乐，关着他的黑暗小屋只有一扇活动小门，他们会从小门丢蟑螂跟小老鼠进来，让那些蟑螂跟小老鼠在他身旁、甚至是身上爬来爬去。

然而就在他快要放弃自我，整个人昏昏沉沉、意识飘散之际，小门被也毫无顾忌——

“现在该怎么办？我刚刚去看过了，警察已经到山脚那儿查探，或许中午过后就会有大批警力来搜山，我可不想被抓。”

“可是我们钱已经收了，不能不顾江湖道义，要不……我们带着这小子换个地方？”

“你蠢蛋喔！带着他跑不了多远，很快就会被发现的，反正姓吴的那个女人只要求我们把她的继子给弄疯，我看这小子现在也差不多了，我们把他抬到山里别的地方丢了，再把这里给破坏掉，赶紧跑路才要紧。”

另外一个坏人似乎被说服了，想了一下之后便同意了。

没多久，他感觉身体被抬了起来，一路颠颠撞撞的，最后被丢在一棵大树下，这其中的颠簸难受他都无所谓，最教他震惊难过、不敢置信的是，刚刚在意识茫然之际所听到的话。

原来这宗绑架案的背后主使者，竟然是他的继母吴佩茹 她原本是父亲的秘书，他母亲去世后她便嫁给了父亲，尽管她也生了小孩，却一直把他视如己出，对待他比对待亲生小孩还要温柔、还要好，怎么会……

他被丢在大树下，近乎崩溃的精神状态加上得知真相那股撕心的痛，还有身体的疲累跟伤痛，没多久他真的昏了过去。

再度醒来时，他已经躺在医院的病床上，病床旁是一脸担忧的父亲和继母吴佩茹，她还温柔的轻抚着他的手背，眼眶含着泪说：“霖儿，你终于醒了，我跟你爸爸都快要担心死了。”

听到她的担心，看到她的泪水，视线再往下看到她覆在他手背上的手，赵霖连忙转过头去，下一秒，他再也忍不住的吐了。

那一年，他才十岁，经历了被绑架的恐惧和被救出来的感恩，虽然他并没有因为这件事而发疯，仍跟继母保持友好关系，但只有他自己知道，他再也不是以前那个天真单纯的赵霖了，一切……都不同了。

第1章(1)

“唉……”面对即将到来的结婚淡季，再想像那门可罗雀的情况，坐在婚顾店紫色吧台后方的白薇秀，忍不住又连叹了三口气，“唉、唉、唉……”

助理育德面无表情的从吧台前晃过，淡淡的道：“薇秀，你一直叹气会把运气都叹光的，到时候生意会更不好。”

她的嘴角抽了一下，握在手中的笔毫不客气的往他丢去，他反应极快，腰一扭就闪过了，也不帮她把笔捡起来，便自顾自的走开了。

白薇秀瞪着他的背影，不满的吐了吐舌，认命的自己去捡笔。这就是店里都是年轻人的缺点，明明自己是合伙人之一，算是半个老板，可是她也不过比其他两位助理大一岁，他们还是她的学弟妹，相处时完全没有老板跟下属的样子，他们有时对她还挺没大没小的。

她是不介意平常和他们嘻嘻哈哈的，这样工作的气氛挺快乐的，也没什么不好，只是偶尔当她想要端一下老板的威严时，却完全威风不起来，真不好玩。

没多久，另外一名助理小真端了杯茶到她面前。“学姊，消消气，别理育德，来，喝口茶，别再叹气了，我相信今年的淡季我们还是可以挺下去。”

瞧瞧，这才是人话，还是小真好，至少喊她的时候还会恭敬的叫声学姊。白薇秀边在心里赞美，边端起小真帮她泡的茶，喝了一口却瞬间五官扭曲。这味道……她是很想吐出来啦，但想想又觉得太浪费，赶紧吞下去，随即哇哇大叫，“小真，你、你是用放在哪里的茶叶泡的 ”

小真坐到她旁边，慢条斯理的拿起杯子啜饮着。“就饮水机上方柜子最左边里面的那罐茶叶。”

“那可是我托人从英国买回来的顶级红茶，是用来接待VIP客人的。”没想到小真这个粗线条的，竟然拿来平常无聊时冲泡，还每人一大杯！白薇秀差点没两眼一翻直接昏倒给她看。

“唉喔，学姊，反正接下来就是淡季，况且茶叶放太久也不好，与其放着浪费，还不如泡给大家喝。”

白薇秀的嘴角猛抽搐，望着杯中的茶，心里挣扎着究竟喝还是不喝，同时把刚刚对小真的称赞全收了回来，又深呼吸了几口气，她才有办法好言好语的道：“就算放久了，味道还是比大卖场一盒才一四九的茶包好，我们喝那种的就好，换喝顶级茶会不习惯。”

小真给了她很鄙视的一眼。“学姊，可是我喝一四九的不习惯耶。”

白薇秀都快喷鼻血了，她是招谁惹谁啊，居然找来这两个天兵助理。

此时店长许安安从外头走了进来，他热得猛拿手中的丝帕擦汗，一瞧白薇秀手中杯子里还有茶，伸手拿过就一饮而尽，喝完还意犹未尽的道：“嗯，店里的茶什么时候换了？这茶挺好喝的，以后就喝这一款吧。”

小真马上狗腿的附和，“店长英明。”

白薇秀狠瞪了败家的合伙人一眼。“不行，这一小罐茶叶就要台币两千元，我们自己喝那么好干么。”

“唉喔，大家平常这么辛苦，犒赏一下……呃、这……”许安安接下来的话，全被白薇秀锐利的眸光给烧得连灰都不剩。

“两千块真的太贵了，还是喝以往那一种就好。”白薇秀相当坚持，反正要是觉得难喝，花自己的钱出去买别的喝就好了。

关于茶包的争论到此告一段落，店里的四个成员外加两名工读生开始大眼瞪小眼，明明是下午三点十分的上班时刻，大伙却没事做，全窝在店里泡茶吃点心闲磕牙。

提前预见婚礼淡季的来临，白薇秀真感到欲哭无泪。

可别以为婚礼企划顾问只要靠一张嘴皮子说动准新人客户把钱拿出来即可，会说话是很重要，但当一个好婚企或好婚顾，除了要懂得察言观色，将客户侍奉好之外，美感也是很重要的。

如何将一场婚礼办得浪漫风光又符合新人的需求，如何帮准新娘挑选出她最期盼且众亲友也满意的婚纱，如何陪新人挑出符合大众口味却又不俗的宴客菜肴，如何细心的帮新人准备让大家都喜爱满意的婚礼小物等等，总之，其中的学问跟功夫可大得呢！
content_en:
In a small space that was invisible and only slightly larger than a dog house, the little boy was trembling all over, huddled in the corner, constantly begging for his mother who had already reached heaven to pick him up.

The two bad guys standing outside would laugh very happily whenever he screamed or cried out of fear. The laughter kept stimulating him. He lowered his head and covered his ears tightly with his hands. His whole body was on the verge of collapse.

He and his younger brother Zhao Yan were kidnapped. Fortunately, on the way here, he noticed the great opportunity that the gangsters had overlooked and asked his younger brother to escape quickly. At first, his younger brother was unwilling and insisted on staying with him. It was only after he threatened and begged that his younger brother agreed to escape first and find someone to help.

At that time, he still had a glimmer of hope, but now he is desperate and just wants to die as soon as possible.

But how easy is it to die?When the two bad guys found out that he started not eating or drinking water, they would force-feed him, and even threatened him that if he didn't eat anymore, they would throw in more cockroaches, rats, or more interesting things, such as snakes.

The two bad guys took pleasure in teasing him. There was only a small trap door in the dark room where he was kept. They would throw cockroaches and mice in through the small door and let the cockroaches and mice crawl around and even on him.

However, just when he was about to give up on himself, his whole body was drowsy and his consciousness was drifting away, the small door quilt had no scruples——

"What should I do now? I just went to check it out. The police have gone to the foot of the mountain to search. Maybe a large number of police will come to search the mountain after noon. I don't want to be caught."

"But we have already collected the money, and we cannot ignore the moral principles of the world. How about... we take this kid to a different place?"

"You idiot! You can't run very far with him, and he will be discovered soon. Anyway, the woman named Wu only asked us to drive her stepson crazy. I think this kid is almost done now. We carry him to another place in the mountains and throw him away. Then we destroy this place. The most important thing is to run away quickly."

The other bad guy seemed convinced and agreed after thinking for a while.

Not long after, he felt his body being lifted up, bumping all the way, and finally being thrown under a big tree. He didn't care about the bumps and discomfort. What shocked him the most, saddened him, and made him unbelievable was the words he just heard when he was unconscious.

It turned out that the person behind the kidnapping case was his stepmother Wu Peiru. She was originally his father's secretary. After his mother passed away, she married his father. Although she also gave birth to a child, she always regarded him as her own and treated him more gently and better than her own child. How could it be...

He was thrown under a big tree. In his nearly collapsed mental state, coupled with the heartbreaking pain of learning the truth, as well as physical fatigue and pain, he really passed out not long after.

When he woke up again, he was already lying on the hospital bed. Beside the hospital bed were his father and stepmother Wu Peiru, who looked worried. She gently stroked the back of his hand and said with tears in her eyes: "Lin'er, you finally woke up. Your father and I are worried to death."

Hearing her worry, seeing her tears, and looking down to see her hand covering the back of his hand, Zhao Lin quickly turned his head. The next second, he couldn't help but vomit.

That year, he was only ten years old, and experienced the fear of being kidnapped and the gratitude of being rescued. Although he did not go crazy because of this incident, and still maintained a friendly relationship with his stepmother, only he knew that he was no longer the innocent and simple Zhao Lin before, everything... was different.

Chapter 1(1)

"Alas..." Faced with the upcoming wedding off-season, and imagining the crowded situation, Bai Weixiu, who was sitting behind the purple bar of the wedding shop, couldn't help but sigh three times in a row, "Alas, alas, alas..."

Assistant Yude walked past the bar with an expressionless face and said calmly: "Weixiu, if you keep sighing, you will lose all your luck, and business will be even worse by then."

The corner of her mouth twitched, and she threw the pen in her hand at him unceremoniously. He reacted very quickly, twisted his waist and dodged it, and walked away without helping her pick up the pen.

Bai Weixiu stared at his back, stuck out her tongue in dissatisfaction, and resigned herself to picking up the pen.This is the shortcoming of the store being full of young people. She is obviously one of the partners and is considered half the boss, but she is only one year older than the other two assistants. They are still her juniors, and they don't act like bosses and subordinates when they get along. Sometimes they treat her like a boss.

She didn't mind chatting with them normally. The working atmosphere was quite happy, and there was nothing wrong with it. But occasionally, when she wanted to show off her boss's dignity, she couldn't do it at all, which was really not fun.

Not long after, another assistant, Xiao Zhen, brought a cup of tea to her."Senior sister, calm down and stop being immoral. Come on, have a sip of tea and stop sighing. I believe we can survive this year's off-season."

Look, this is what a human would say. It’s really good to be a little girl. At least when you call her, you will call her senior respectfully.Bai Weixiu praised in her heart while picking up the tea Xiaozhen made for her. After taking a sip, her facial features were instantly distorted.This taste... She wanted to spit it out, but after thinking about it, she felt it was too wasteful, so she quickly swallowed it, and then yelled, "Xiao Zhen, you, you made it with the tea leaves you put somewhere."

Xiaozhen sat next to her, slowly picked up the cup and sipped."It's the can of tea on the far left side of the cabinet above the water dispenser."

"That's the top-grade black tea I asked someone to buy back from the UK. It's used to receive VIP guests." I didn't expect that Xiao Zhen, a thick-skinned person, would actually use it to brew it when he was bored, and give each person a large cup!Bai Weixiu almost fainted without rolling her eyes and showed it to her.

"Oh, senior sister, it's off-season anyway, and it's not good to leave the tea for too long. Rather than leaving it to waste, it's better to brew it for everyone to drink."

The corners of Bai Weixiu's mouth twitched fiercely, and she looked at the tea in the cup, struggling in her mind whether to drink it or not. At the same time, she took back all the compliments she had just given to Xiaozhen, and took a few deep breaths before she could find a way to speak nicely: "Even if it's been left for a long time, the taste is still better than a box of 149 tea bags in a hypermarket. We just drink that kind. We won't get used to drinking top-quality tea."

Xiaozhen gave her a look of disdain."Senior sister, I'm not used to drinking 149."

Bai Weixiu almost had a nosebleed. Who was she provoking? She actually found these two heavenly soldiers assistants.

At this time, the store manager Xu Anan came in from the outside. He was so hot that he wiped the sweat with the silk handkerchief in his hand. When he saw that there was still tea in the cup in Bai Weixiu's hand, he reached for it and drank it all in one gulp. After drinking, he still said with unfinished content: "Well, when did the tea in the store change? This tea is very delicious. I will drink this one from now on."

Xiao Zhen immediately agreed, "The store manager is wise."

Bai Weixiu glared at the prodigal partner."No, this small pot of tea costs NT$2,000. How can we drink it ourselves?"

"Oh, everyone works so hard, let's give it a reward... uh, this..." Xu Anan's next words were burned to ashes by Bai Weixiu's sharp eyes.

"Two thousand yuan is really too expensive. Just drink the same drink as before." Bai Weixiu insisted. Anyway, if you find it unpleasant to drink, just spend your own money to buy something else.

The debate about the tea bags came to an end. The four members of the store and the two work-study students started to stare at each other. It was clearly time to go to work at 3:10 in the afternoon, but everyone had nothing to do. They were all sitting in the store making tea, eating snacks and chatting.

Anticipating the arrival of wedding off-season in advance, Bai Wei Xiuzhen felt like crying.

Don’t think that a wedding planning consultant can just rely on words to convince prospective couples to spend their money. Being able to speak is very important. But to be a good wedding planner or wedding consultant, in addition to knowing how to observe words and emotions and serve customers well, beauty is also very important.

How to make a wedding romantic and beautiful and meet the needs of the couple, how to help the bride-to-be choose the wedding dress that she looks forward to most and that all her relatives and friends will be satisfied with, how to accompany the couple to choose delicious banquet dishes that are in line with public tastes, how to carefully help the couple prepare wedding favors that everyone will love and be satisfied with, etc. In short, it requires a lot of knowledge and effort!
